items.listing: n:2026-11-25|Five more schools: Bregy, Hartranft, Peirce, Barry and Welsh

fields.new: Five more schools: Bregy, Hartranft, Peirce, Barry and Welsh

Each has its own page with what runs there, what picks up from it and what’s a short walk away. New to the site are Sunrise’s after-school programs inside Bregy in South Philadelphia and Barry in West Philadelphia; the YMCA’s free after care at Hartranft; Launch Philly’s free before and after care at Peirce, with Shuler Playground a short walk away; and Methodist Services’ free after-school program at Welsh. Each school’s own clubs and partners are listed too. That makes 91 schools in all.
